end.summary: Practised recognising equal parts and naming halves, thirds, and quarters.
end.parentNote: Nisha practised identifying equal shares and matching the number of selected parts with the whole. They connected the top number with one piece taken, but mixed up the bottom number with pieces left; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, use a cake or paper shape cut into equal parts and ask, “How many equal parts altogether?” before naming the fraction.
